disagreement_rule: If rules.json and RULES.md disagree, the affected verdict is reported as inconclusive and the disagreement is logged.
scope: Entry 25 mouth-aspect rule for every Entry 25 roster cave, and model declarations for the eight IV/17 coverage branches. Exploratory. No identification claim. No registered result changes.

exposure.label: EVIDENCE
exposure.text: Sion 2002 Plan 5 chord-normal proxies about 123 deg (northern) and 119 deg (southern) from the drawn arrow; endpoint ranges 99.5-140.8 and 104.0-132.4 deg; pilot envelopes 101-151 and 103-143 deg; north convention unspecified.

exposure.label: EVIDENCE
exposure.text: Northern-minus-southern midpoint offset about 2.63 m north and 3.30 m east; northern present chord about 0.86 m (0.59-1.16 m); Plan 5 shows no excavation limits; Sion p. 63 places the excavation at the centres of both spaces.

exposure.label: EVIDENCE
exposure.text: Bar-Adon describes both Twin Cave openings as east-facing; Feig describes IV/11's internal pillar without a documented exterior pair.

exposure.label: INFERENCE
exposure.text: Disclosure: the northern endpoint range already crosses the 135 deg edge of the primary east sector; the line joining the IV/17 mouth midpoints runs roughly north-east to south-west. No verdict of these rules was computed on any real record.

exposure.label: EVIDENCE
exposure.text: Not seen: the L-656 file, any IAA cave record, and the unread Atiqot 41 cave entries named in the IAA item file.

text_basis.label: EVIDENCE
text_basis.text: VI 2 reads [ה]פתחין הצופא מזרח in the project text; Puech prints the article before צופא as an editorial correction.

text_basis.label: EVIDENCE
text_basis.text: Milik 1960 p. 140 attaches the eastward aspect to the cave; Puech 2015 pp. 59-60 gives no explicit two-mouth requirement.

aspect_rule.candidates_note: The same rule applies to every Entry 25 roster cave and to any cave added later.
aspect_rule.record_identity: A record counts for a cave only if it names the cave's survey number or a recorded crosswalk links them; otherwise it is silent for that cave.

north_reference.label: ASSUMPTION
north_reference.reason: East (the side of sunrise) is an astronomical direction.

cases.applies_when: grid north (Old Israel Grid, ITM, Palestine grid)
cases.note: INFERENCE: both Israeli grids have a central meridian near 35.2 E; near 35.4 E, 31.8 N the convergence is near 0.1 deg.

cases.applies_when: magnetic north with a stated declination
north convention not stated (for example Plan 5's arrow)
cases.label: ASSUMPTION
cases.reason: A magnetic arrow would put true direction a few degrees east in recent decades; a symmetric 6 deg also covers a grid or true mix-up. Check against IGRF before use.

primary.definition: Outward normal of the aperture chord joining the two rock-cut jamb points of the mouth.
primary.chord: Narrowest rock-cut section at the threshold level when drawn; otherwise where the drawn mouth line meets each jamb.
primary.outward: The side away from the chamber the mouth leads into.
primary.masonry: Excluded. A partly blocked mouth is measured on its rock-cut jambs. A hidden or undrawn rock-cut jamb makes the mouth not measurable.

sensitivity.definition: From the midpoint of the inner chord to the midpoint of the outer chord; only where a passage is drawn. Reported only.

endpoint_radius_m.label: ASSUMPTION
endpoint_radius_m.reason: Rock-cut jamb edges are ragged at the decimetre scale; the repository's Plan 5 repeat used +/-5-6 px (about +/-0.09-0.11 m) per coordinate.

north_arrow_endpoint.label: ASSUMPTION
north_arrow_endpoint.reason: The Plan 5 repeat used +/-2 px for the arrow endpoints.

distortion_deg.label: ASSUMPTION
distortion_deg.reason: A flat scan of a printed plan keeps angles to about a degree.

reported_azimuth_precision_deg.label: ASSUMPTION
reported_azimuth_precision_deg.reason: Compass readings on irregular cave mouths.

compass_word.unknown_resolution: 8 if the record uses any intercardinal word, otherwise 4
compass_word.label: ASSUMPTION
compass_word.reason: A compass word's bin is far wider than any north offset.

direction_words.primary_reason: Four-wind partition: with only four direction words, a facing nearer east than north or south is east.

primary_evidence.label: EVIDENCE
primary_evidence.text: The project translation uses only the four cardinal words and no intercardinal compound.

sensitivity_sectors.label: ASSUMPTION
sensitivity_sectors.reason: A stricter reader who would call a north-east facing north-east.

sensitivity_sectors.label: INFERENCE
sensitivity_sectors.reason: The word is built on the root for the sun's rising; solstice sunrise azimuths at the sites.

sensitivity_sectors.label: ASSUMPTION
sensitivity_sectors.reason: A loose reader who calls any eastern-side facing east.

direction_words.label: INFERENCE
direction_words.reason: The northern opening is the northern member of the pair; it need not face north (direction review). A facing-north reading is not a retained branch.

northern_member_rule.delta: northing(Ma) - northing(Mb) in true north, Ma and Mb the mouth-chord midpoints
northern_member_rule.interval: range of delta over north directions within +/-alpha, widened by +/-2r
northern_member_rule.decided: Ma is northern if the whole interval is above zero; Mb if wholly below zero
northern_member_rule.class_effect: none; it cannot contradict the existing northern-member checks
northern_member_rule.consequence: Undetermined leaves the IV/17 origin and zone undefined, so all eight branches are undeterminable.

decision_rule.pass: the whole interval lies inside the closed sector
decision_rule.fail: the interval and the sector share no arc of positive length; touching at one edge counts as no overlap
decision_rule.inconclusive: otherwise; a full-circle interval is always inconclusive
decision_rule.not_measurable: the record covers the cave but lacks a needed element (north arrow, grid or convention; scale where needed; a jamb; distinguishable mouths)
decision_rule.silent: the record gives no geometry or facing for that cave

both_mouths.not_measurable: both mouths not measurable, or the record shows fewer than two mouths
both_mouths.single_value_rule: A single facing value for a two-mouth cave is cave-level evidence only.

cave.interval: smallest arc containing the facade-normal interval and the mean-mouth-facing interval
cave.facade_normal: outward normal of the chord joining the two mouth-chord midpoints; outward is the normal within 90 deg of the mean mouth facing; half-width uses D, the midpoint distance, for L; with more than two mouths use the two midpoints farthest apart
cave.mean_mouth_facing: from the mean of the lower ends to the mean of the upper ends, after unwrapping; not measurable if the mouth intervals ever lie 180 deg apart
cave.single_record_value: a record's single facing value or word for the cave is used directly
cave.label: ASSUMPTION
cave.reason: The cave facing east can mean the cliff frontage or the direction its openings face; a verdict is decisive only when both senses agree.

phase_rule.default: A verdict on rock-cut jambs applies to both phase branches (reported and ancient), as the decisions bearing component does.
phase_rule.exception: If the record shows the rock-cut aperture was cut or enlarged after the ancient phase, the verdict applies to phase = reported only; the ancient branches stay undetermined.
phase_rule.sensitivity: Strict: the verdict reaches the ancient branches only when the jamb cutting is dated before or within the ancient phase.
phase_rule.label: ASSUMPTION

record_combination.exposed_records: Records already in the repository are never scored under this rule; their inventory values stay as recorded.
record_combination.new_records: Each new record is scored on its own. PASS with FAIL gives INCONCLUSIVE, both reported. A decisive verdict with an inconclusive one keeps the decisive verdict.
record_combination.earlier_description: If a new decisive verdict disagrees with an earlier published description, report the disagreement; the new verdict drives the class effect.

class_effects.note: c01 survives through its IV/11 and Twin Cave members; its class must be recomputed.

aspect_rule.class_effects_default: Any outcome not listed (pass, inconclusive, not-measurable or silent for any cave and level) has no effect and removes no class.
aspect_rule.sensitivity_reporting: Report every verdict under every sensitivity sector, uncertainty alternative, the passage-axis measure and the strict phase reading. Sensitivity results never change the class effect; any PASS-FAIL flip is stated in the report.

frame.primary: The L-656 plan's own frame, imported into the states register with metres_per_unit, north_vector and y_axis.
frame.alternative: states-iv17-plan5-crop, only with a recorded registration of the L-656 cuts to it.

threshold_chord.primary: rock-cut jamb-to-jamb chord of the northern mouth at the ancient threshold surface
threshold_chord.fallback: the record's drawn mouth line at its rock-cut jambs; results labelled present-state chord

origin_point.primary: midpoint of the threshold chord, in frame units
sensitivity: midpoint of the inner chord where a passage is drawn

zone_outline.shape: rectangle aligned with the threshold chord
zone_outline.along_chord: jamb to jamb, extended by r at each end
zone_outline.across_chord: d_out + r outward and d_in + r inward from the chord line; extended to the inner chord plus r where a passage is drawn farther inward
zone_outline.label: ASSUMPTION
zone_outline.reason: In the northern opening starts the digging at the doorway; about one cubit either side of the threshold line holds where a person standing there would dig.

sector.centre: inward normal of the threshold chord (outward facing + 180 deg), measured with the frame's own north_vector
sector.north_correction: none; target and cuts share the frame
sector.label: INFERENCE (inward) and ASSUMPTION (45 deg)
sector.reason: The entry opens in the cave, so a horizontal measure from the opening runs inward; 45 deg is the four-wind half-width used for the east sector.

instruction_tolerance_m.label: ASSUMPTION
instruction_tolerance_m.reason: How closely a counted three-cubit distance places the jar.

vertical.rule: three cubits from the measure band
vertical.label: ASSUMPTION
vertical.reason: The project's exploratory 0.40-0.60 m cubit range; not a textual calibration.

horizontal.label: ASSUMPTION
horizontal.reason: The horizontal reading states no depth; the bound reuses the deepest three-cubit length in the project range, so a dig must reach that deep before the branch counts as covered.

reference_surface.range_rule: If the threshold is a range, run the join at its lowest and highest level; the status holds only if both runs agree, otherwise undeterminable.
reference_surface.label: ASSUMPTION

footprint_reading.levels: Cut outline and top and lowest-reached levels from the L-656 plan, level register or basket register, in the threshold's datum.
footprint_reading.spot_levels: Use the highest recorded bottom for the covered test and the lowest recorded bottom for the not-covered test.
footprint_reading.no_absence: The join never infers that a deposit is absent; carried components do not change the spatial status; a covered branch still needs the six negative-excavation gates.

volume_join_fields.note: The join merges option parameters per dimension. distance_band_m on the range cubit option is ignored by the vertical model. radial_tolerance_m applies only to single-cubit horizontal branches.

requirements.text: both rock-cut jambs of the northern mouth (threshold_chord)
threshold elevation or range, its datum and its phase (reference_surface)
top and lowest-reached level of every cut, in the threshold's datum

covered.condition: the cuts together contain the whole branch outline over the whole depth interval, at both threshold levels and with the highest recorded bottoms

partly_covered.condition: the cuts contain part but not all of the branch volume

not_covered.condition: every cut lies wholly outside the branch outline, or wholly above or below its depth interval, at both threshold levels and with the lowest recorded bottoms

undeterminable.condition: anything else; list the missing parameters by their volume_join.py names

iv17_target_declarations.class_effect: none; coverage outcomes remove no Entry 25 class
iv17_target_declarations.arrival_register_note: The arrival register's coverage prediction concerns the joins without declarations. These rules leave it as frozen; a run with these declarations is a separate evaluation.
